svg.title: dsh-price-less — Architecture
svg.desc: Context-management plugin for DeepSeek Harness · R1–R4 fully implemented (incl. F1–F13 / P14c·d / P17c / P20c field fixes) · docs/11-structure.md
svg.text: Context-management plugin for DeepSeek Harness · R1–R4 fully implemented (incl. F1–F13 / P14c·d / P17c / P20c field fixes) · docs/11-structure.md
workspace isolation: archive/prefix keys keyed by session header.cwd (F3)
src/core/ · pure kernel (zero harness imports; decides how to compute)
instruction → keyword rules → past verdicts → light model
T0 superseded · T0-R repair · run flush
closed-task discovery → one call → shrink check → txn
zero model calls · zero history edits
read overwritten by a later write
repair declaration reads only, never content
step order · entity audit · dual-source equivalence
task dossier · project brief · boundary archive · artifacts
checkout/merge — trading space for efficiency · prior: 5.5% parallel face
M0 gate: isolatable live context ≥30%, break cost <20% of saving
exit gate: protocol probe + gateway re-encode + behaviour A/B
Discipline: cut points fixed before results are booked (T-entry) · no behavioural signals · failure = keep · out-of-band (internal flags never enter model view) · byte-reproducible
core + domains reach harness state only via platform

Solid = implemented (R1–R4, incl. F1–F13 / P14c·d / P17c / P20c field fixes). Dashed = pending validation. H* = harness hooks (docs/10-wiring.md). Retired designs (N-series negotiation shear · T-loop) → docs/legacy.md.
